WITH same_station AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        starttime
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        a.start_station_id,
        a.starttime as trip_start
    FROM same_station a
    JOIN same_station b 
        ON a.start_station_id = b.start_station_id
        AND a.starttime != b.starttime
        AND ABS(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(a.starttime, b.starttime, SECOND)) <= 120
),
group_trip_times AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT start_station_id, trip_start
    FROM pairs
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT CAST(start_station_id AS STRING) as station_id, COUNT(*) as group_trip_count
    FROM group_trip_times
    GROUP BY CAST(start_station_id AS STRING)
),
total_end_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(end_station_id AS STRING) as station_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY CAST(end_station_id AS STRING)
),
station_names_from_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(start_station_id AS STRING) as station_id,
        start_station_name,
        COUNT(*) as name_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY CAST(start_station_id AS STRING), start_station_name
),
most_common_name AS (
    SELECT station_id, start_station_name as trip_name
    FROM (
        SELECT station_id, start_station_name,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY name_count DESC) as rn
        FROM station_names_from_trips
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(s.name, mc.trip_name) as station_name,
    CAST(tc.station_id AS INT64) as station_id,
    gc.group_trip_count,
    tc.total_trips_ending,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(gc.group_trip_count, tc.total_trips_ending) as proportion
FROM total_end_counts tc
LEFT JOIN group_counts gc ON tc.station_id = gc.station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s ON tc.station_id = s.station_id
LEFT JOIN most_common_name mc ON tc.station_id = mc.station_id
WHERE gc.group_trip_count > 0
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10
